description:
Implement the designed field-generic block-code, encoding, generator-matrix, and parity-check trait surface with packed `BitVec`/`BitMatrix` binary specializations, and stand up the named compatibility boundary so existing code families compile unchanged.

## Background

This is the trait cutover child shared with the streaming/batch unification story: that story builds on these traits rather than designing a competing surface. Existing families (LDPC, CRC, product, GRAND consumers) remain on the compatibility boundary until their own migrations; BCH migrates within this epic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The designed generic traits exist with binary specializations preserving packed behavior, and static generic implementations dispatch with zero-cost monomorphization.
- [hard] REQ-02: The named, versioned compatibility boundary keeps existing consumer families compiling and passing tests unchanged, with its removal condition recorded.
- [hard] REQ-03: Workspace tests, clippy with warnings denied, and formatting pass.
title: Introduce field-generic block-code traits with binary specializations
